annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses rely on the same relevant technical evidence (queue stats/depth, worker logs, traces, recent deploy/config changes, and signs of errors/retries/timeouts), propose the same kinds of discriminating checks (patterns by job/time, upstream slowdown vs worker saturation, baseline comparison), and reach the same diagnostic posture (narrow the cause before another fix; determine whether the issue is in workers or upstream). The differences are only in brevity and wording, not in decision-relevant evidence or operational commitments.
